redimensionar-lote.title: Batch Image Resize
redimensionar-lote.description: Resize many images at once to the same width, height and format. Free, no account, and nothing ever leaves your device.
redimensionar-lote.cta: Need to process thousands of catalog images or plug this into your own system? We can build that automation for you.
redimensionar-lote.seoTitle: Resize Multiple Images Online Free | SonhoLab
redimensionar-lote.seoDescription: Resize a whole batch of images to the same width, height and format (JPG, PNG or WEBP) for free, right in your browser. Files never leave your device.
redimensionar-lote.intro: If you run an online store, put together photos from an event, or prep images for a school project, resizing one picture at a time rarely cuts it — you need dozens of files at the exact same width, height and format, and doing that one by one gets old fast. This tool lets you upload several images at once, set a single target size and output format, and apply it to the whole batch in one step. Everything happens right in your browser, so your photos never leave your device, and in the end you download them one by one or all together in a single ZIP file, ready to use wherever you need them.
redimensionar-lote.stepsHeading: How to batch resize images in 3 steps
redimensionar-lote.step1Text: Drag several images into the upload area or pick them from your device — there's no strict limit on how many. They load straight into your browser, and nothing gets uploaded to a server, so the process starts instantly with no waiting around.
redimensionar-lote.step2Text: Type the width and height in pixels you want for every image, and choose an output format: JPG, PNG or WEBP. That same size and format gets applied to the entire batch at once, so you never have to set it up image by image.
redimensionar-lote.step3Text: Download each resized image individually, or grab them all together in one ZIP file. Your original images stay untouched, so you can run the batch again with a different size or format as many times as you need, without losing any of your source material.
redimensionar-lote.useCase1: A seller with a hundred products in their online store needs every photo to be exactly the same size before uploading them to the catalog or a marketplace that requires uniform dimensions.
redimensionar-lote.useCase2: A student preparing photos for a project or a printed photo book needs all the images to match in size before sending them off to print, without opening each one in a different editor.
redimensionar-lote.useCase3: A small brand wants every photo on its Instagram grid to share the same proportions, without opening each image one at a time in a photo editor.
redimensionar-lote.faq1q: What happens to my images when I resize them?
redimensionar-lote.faq1a: Nothing leaves your device. Resizing happens entirely in your browser, using your own computer's processor, so your images never travel to any server, ours or anyone else's. Once you close the tab, no copy is kept anywhere.
redimensionar-lote.faq2q: How many images can I process at once?
redimensionar-lote.faq2a: There's no fixed limit — you can load anywhere from a handful to several hundred images in one batch, depending on how much memory your browser has available. It's free no matter how many you process, with no account and no email required.
redimensionar-lote.faq3q: Will my images end up stretched or distorted?
redimensionar-lote.faq3a: They can, if you mix photos with very different aspect ratios and force one fixed width and height: the tool fits every image to those exact dimensions, but it doesn't do smart cropping to preserve the subject's framing. For the best results, use images that already share a similar aspect ratio, or leave some margin around the subject.
redimensionar-lote.faq4q: Which output formats can I choose from?
redimensionar-lote.faq4a: You can convert the whole batch to JPG, PNG or WEBP, no matter what format each image started in. That's handy for switching heavy photos to WEBP to speed up an online store, or for unifying a catalog that arrived in mixed formats.
redimensionar-lote.faq5q: Do I need to install anything to use this tool?
redimensionar-lote.faq5a: No. It runs in the browser you already have, on a computer or tablet, with nothing to install and no special permissions to read your files. For large batches, a computer is a better bet than a phone, since your browser will need more memory available to process all the images at once.
